_about: EchoCombat's values, in the shape of the game's mp_weapon_settings.json. Every deploy / release merges them into the game's own mp_weapon_settings (packed with the rest of the game data, so change a value here, then deploy or make the release again). Keys the game itself does not use (OVERCHARGE's damage_bonus_* / head_body_part / cheat_death_* / link_window_ms / heal_fraction, the veil_* smoke look, POINT's and the translocator's effect_* / sound_copies) are read by the build tools, and OVERCHARGE's by PowerBoost.dll through PowerBoost.ini.

magnum._why: PROTOSTAR head hit 70 (45 x 1.5556; stock 1.5 x 50 = 75).

smg._why: QUARK: stock instability cooled from 0.05 s after a shot while it fires every 0.06 s, so per shot it gained +0.2 and lost 15/s x ~0.01 s: a +0.05 margin that frame timing tipped either way (some players never got spread, others hit the 3.5 max in a few shots). Cooling now waits 0.1 s (only once you stop firing, as on the other guns), and +0.05 per shot keeps the intended ramp: full spread after ~20 shots.
smg._why_vent: Venting from full heat takes 1.4 s (stock 120/s: ~0.8 s), with the heat cap of 100.

chain._why: BLAZAR: 60 shots before it overheats, 20% more (stock 2 heat a shot: 50), with the heat cap of 100.

magnum._why: PROTOSTAR: 45 a body hit (stock 50; the head multiplier in damage_table makes 70 a head hit), 0.6 s between shots (stock 0.5), and 10% faster shots (44 m/s, stock 40).
